questions.prompt: A cyclist travels 600 m in 120 s. What is her average speed in m/s?
Which of these is a **vector** quantity?
questions.explanation: Velocity has both size and direction.

questions.prompt: A bus accelerates from 4 m/s to 16 m/s in 6 s. Find its acceleration in m/s².
On a distance–time graph, a horizontal line means the object is…
questions.explanation: The distance is not changing, so the object is not moving.

questions.prompt: If you walk around a running track and finish where you started, your displacement is zero.
questions.explanation: Displacement is the straight-line change in position; you are back at the start.
